ontario-science-g8-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 8 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess developments in cell biology and their impact on individuals, society, and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess developments in cell biology and their impact on individuals, society, and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic structure and function of plant and animal cells and cell processes
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic structure and function of plant and animal cells and cell processes

standards.summaryText: analyse uses of various technologies that rely on the properties of fluids, and assess the impact of these technologies on society and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: analyse uses of various technologies that rely on the properties of fluids, and assess the impact of these technologies on society and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of basic fluid mechanics, including the properties and uses of fluids
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of basic fluid mechanics, including the properties and uses of fluids

standards.summaryText: assess the social and environmental impacts of various systems, and evaluate improvements to the systems or alternative ways of meeting the same needs
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the social and environmental impacts of various systems, and evaluate improvements to the systems or alternative ways of meeting the same needs
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of different types of systems and the factors that contribute to their safe and efficient operation
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of different types of systems and the factors that contribute to their safe and efficient operation

standards.summaryText: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the sustainability of water resources
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the sustainability of water resources
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the characteristics of Earth’s water systems and of factors that affect these systems
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the characteristics of Earth’s water systems and of factors that affect these systems
